title: The Goblin was gone before the answer arrived
era: 1994 Fallen Empires kitchen-table red aggro teaching model
story: I had Mons's Goblin Raiders on the battlefield and my opponent was at five life. During my main phase I tapped a Mountain for red mana, announced Goblin Grenade targeting them, and sacrificed the Raiders as an additional casting cost. My opponent held up blue mana for Counterspell , but they could not destroy the sacrificed Goblin before I paid that cost. They let the spell resolve. Grenade dealt five damage and ended the game. I still had Lightning Bolt in hand, but the five-damage spell had done enough. The Goblin had gone to the graveyard before anyone could answer Grenade.
review: Mons's Goblin Raiders is a Goblin. Mountain pays R; sacrifice Raiders is additional spell cost, occurs before priority response. Opponent has Counterspell but declines. Resolved spell deals 5 to 5-life player, lethal. All cards printed by 1994, fictitious deck.
